summary: Bell Canada announced pricing of cash tender offers to purchase multiple series of its outstanding MTN debentures, accepting C$301,113,000 of Series M-39 (2045), C$366,626,000 of Series M-45 (2047), C$380,000,000 of Series M-60 (2028), C$60,000,000 of Series M-3 (2029), and C$345,000,000 of Series M-52 (2030). Total Consideration ranged from C$933.24 to C$1,082.62 per C$1,000 principal, set via fixed spreads over Reference Yields (e.g., 110 bps for long maturities). BCE Inc. guarantees the debentures. The offers were made via an Offer to Purchase dated May 27, 2026, with increased Maximum Purchase Amounts announced May 27 and June 3, 2026. The company excluded certain other series tendered. Watch for early settlement and any proration, as the offers reduce outstanding debt and change Bell's capital structure.
